nodes.label: Row-Level Security tenant isolation
nodes.rationale: Every tenant-scoped table gets ENABLE+FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY plus a tenant_isolation policy keyed off current_setting('app.tenant_id'). Defense-in-depth: even if application code forgets a WHERE tenant_id clause, Postgres itself refuses to return/write rows outside the session's tenant context. An unset app.tenant_id resolves to NULL via nullif(), matching nothing, so a transaction that forgets tenant context fails safely (zero rows) instead of leaking data.

nodes.label: Composite (tenant_id, id) foreign key pattern
nodes.rationale: Every multi-tenant table uses composite PK (tenant_id, id), and every FK carries tenant_id alongside the referenced id, so a row can never be joined/referenced across tenant boundaries even if application code forgets a WHERE tenant_id clause -- the foreign key itself enforces same-tenant linkage.

nodes.label: UUIDv7 application-generated primary keys
nodes.rationale: Primary keys are uuid, generated by the application as UUIDv7, which is time-ordered so it indexes/sorts almost as well as a sequence while remaining safe to generate client-side -- offline mobile clients can create IDs before ever reaching the server -- and safe to expose externally.

nodes.label: Leak panel
nodes.rationale: Owner dashboard surfacing verified-vs-claimed travel km and attendance anomalies from day one, designed to end payroll leakage (targeted ~15-22% of field payroll in the ICP); called out as 'this screen alone was the sales-close moment.'

nodes.label: Entitlement engine
nodes.rationale: Shows what's covered under a site's AMC contract on the job card before the technician starts, designed specifically to end on-site billing arguments between technicians and facility managers.

nodes.label: Offline-first mobile app
nodes.rationale: Captures a full day's work (checklist, photos, parts, signature) locally with zero signal and syncs in order once back in range, because most field work happens in lift shafts/basements -- the worst GPS/signal environment in the building.

nodes.label: Renewal ladder (90/60/30/7-day)
nodes.rationale: Auto-drafted quotes and WhatsApp e-acceptance at 90/60/30/7 days before AMC expiry, so a 'lapsed but still being serviced' contract triggers an alarm instead of silent revenue leakage.

nodes.label: Evidence bundle
nodes.rationale: Geofenced check-in/out, timestamped photos, and signature/OTP turn a multi-day service dispute investigation into a one-click lookup.

nodes.label: Same-day onboarding
nodes.rationale: Live on the platform the day of signup via vertical config templates, positioned as the documented gap versus ServiceTitan-class competitors whose custom builds run ~3 months.

nodes.label: Role & permission system (RB1-RB8)
nodes.rationale: Scope dimensions (own-records/own-team/branch/all) enforced server-side, deny-by-default baseline, so a modified mobile client can't bypass access control and nothing is accidentally over-exposed.

nodes.label: Time-boxed impersonation consent token
nodes.rationale: Support Agent may only impersonate a user after requesting a time-boxed consent token from the tenant admin; a persistent banner stays visible and every impersonated action is tagged distinctly in the tenant's own audit log, so support access can't quietly become surveillance.

nodes.label: 2-person rule on destructive platform ops
nodes.rationale: Every destructive tenant-lifecycle action taken by the Platform Super Admin is gated behind a second approver so no single internal actor can unilaterally damage a tenant.

nodes.label: Field Service Platform Database Schema Reference
Operational deployment notes (partitioning, PostGIS, read replicas)
nodes.rationale: Deployment guidance to apply after workload testing, not baked into DDL: partition high-volume append-only tables (task_status_history, gps_events, sync_mutations, audit_logs) by month; add PostGIS geography+GiST if radius/nearest-site queries become frequent; keep evidence bytes out of Postgres (object storage only); use read replicas/materialized views for dashboards; revoke UPDATE/DELETE privileges on logically-immutable tables.

nodes.label: SOLID/DRY/KISS/YAGNI code principles
nodes.rationale: Universal code principles binding on all contributors: single responsibility via events instead of direct cross-domain service calls, open/closed via polymorphic providers instead of if/else dispatch, dependency inversion via infrastructure/ adapters so no domain service imports a concrete third-party client directly.

nodes.label: tenantId-from-JWT-only rule
nodes.rationale: tenantId is NEVER accepted from request body, query param, or any client-controlled input -- it is extracted from the verified JWT only, and every Prisma query in a repository must include tenantId in its WHERE clause (Security Rule N1/N2), layered on top of database-level Row-Level Security as defense-in-depth.

nodes.label: Client-generated idempotencyKey pattern
nodes.rationale: idempotencyKey is required on every mutation endpoint and generated on the client at the moment of user action, not at send time; replaying the same key returns the cached original result as a 409 that the client treats as success -- essential for offline-first mobile submissions that may retry after reconnecting.

nodes.label: Audit log vs operational log separation
nodes.rationale: Two separate systems: Winston/CloudWatch operational logs (engineering debug/alerting, 30-day retention, must not contain PII) versus the append-only hash-chained audit_logs table (business accountability/compliance, 6-8 year retention, contains entity diffs). Neither substitutes for the other; both are mandatory.

nodes.label: Phase 1: fast feedback during development
nodes.rationale: flutter analyze && flutter test locally, golden/screenshot tests, and PR-gated emulator integration tests catch agent-introduced regressions before merge without a human clicking through the app or an AI agent judging whether output 'looks right' -- deterministic assertions only.

nodes.label: Phase 2: continuous production verification
nodes.rationale: EventBridge-scheduled Lambdas (synthetic API tests, nightly AWS Device Farm runs, deploy-time smoke tests) catch the world changing underneath a build that was correct when it shipped -- RDS out of connections, PowerSync stopped replicating, WhatsApp BSP integration silently failing.
